WITH p AS (SELECT coalesce(lower(trim(cast(p."posting_id" as varchar))), 'null') AS k0,coalesce(lower(trim(cast(p."referral_rate_pct" as varchar))), 'null') AS v,count(*) AS n FROM prediction."intermediate"."int_lever__posting_analytics" p GROUP BY ALL), g AS (SELECT coalesce(lower(trim(cast(g."posting_id" as varchar))), 'null') AS k0,coalesce(lower(trim(cast(g."referral_rate_pct" as varchar))), 'null') AS v,count(*) AS n FROM gold."intermediate"."int_lever__posting_analytics" g GROUP BY ALL),
      residual AS (SELECT coalesce(p.k0,g.k0) AS k0,
        greatest(coalesce(p.n,0)-coalesce(g.n,0),0) AS pn,
        greatest(coalesce(g.n,0)-coalesce(p.n,0),0) AS gn
        FROM p FULL OUTER JOIN g USING (k0,v)),
      per_key AS (SELECT k0,sum(pn) AS pn,sum(gn) AS gn FROM residual GROUP BY ALL)
      SELECT coalesce(sum(least(pn,gn)),0) FROM per_key
